page.overview:
Who is Boneripper?

Boneripper, called "Bone-thing" by other Skaven, was a Rat Ogre, perhaps the best known of the named Rat Ogres among the Skaven. Owned by the infamous Grey Seer Thanquol, he acted as a mount and bodyguard, and his presence was often the difference between life and death for the Grey Seer. In truth, there have been many Bonerippers, as Thanquol's plots often saw his bodyguard slain in Thanquol's stead.

As a massive Rat Ogre, the original Boneripper was a completely (more or less) organic being. He was a three-armed monster, one arm bearing a sword, the other a firearm, and the final limb ending in a set of fearsome claws. The head of the beast was skeletal with fearsome red eyes, feeding into a shaggy mane of fur.

Like all Rat Ogres, Boneripper was covered in all manner of stitches and sutures which held the beast together. Loyal and more-or-less obedient to Thanquol, Boneripper seeks the approval of his master even if the Grey Seer is often verbally abusive and more than willing to put his well-being before the Rat Ogre's own.

After one of his deaths, Boneripper was rebuilt as a Stormfiend by the tinker-ratmen of Clan Skryre. Using the Warp-Tooth, he was much more dangerous and more importantly, much more easy to control. Thanquol suspected even the Grey Seers' ruling Seer Lord Kritislik would hesitate to take action against this new and improved flesh-and-metal Boneripper.
